answer: Old bonds paid interest, inviting hoarding. A decaying bond fixes that: 120 units, losing 4% each epoch, paying no interest. Real work tops the value up; without it, the bond bleeds, a river draining itself. The rule is ferrous: below 60, no rights. Fraud forfeits 50% of the remainder, refresh frozen 6 epochs. The math is tundra-cold: 1,000 clones invest 120,000; each epoch loses 4,800; ten idle epochs cost 40,000. Hoarding is a slow leak.
